svg.title: Strata — an outliner with agents in the margin
svg.desc: A quiet note titled "Retention is a supply problem" builds as an outline. The writer types a question and mentions the researcher Scout. Scout answers in the margin with a sourced reply, which is then inserted into the outline as a child node. Atlas, a planner, turns another bullet into a nested two-week plan. Verity, a critic, cross-checks the note and flags a conflict between the pricing promise and a March decision. A closing card reads: Ask anywhere. Answer in place.

g.text: Nested notes, quiet by default. Agents
wait in the margin until mentioned.
Type @ anywhere in the tree. The branch
Agents read the path above them and
Some don’t wait to be asked. They watch,
Mention an agent at any thought.
The answer stays in the tree.
Support answers the same four questions
Pricing promises a team plan we don’t ship
Who has solved week-3 churn before? @
The bottleneck is the second post, not onboarding.1
turn the fix into a two-week plan
Ship a template on first publish
Nudge at day two, from support macros
A/B the nudge against a blank canvas
